Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a bonus when the leftover after placement is a multiple of 10, so round-numbered residuals outrank slightly tighter irregular ones. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when the tightest leftover is not a multiple of 10 while another is. It may help if round residuals align with common item sizes, or fail because divisibility by 10 is arbitrary and may override genuinely better fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (40 if (r - item) % 10 == 0 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
